studies.title: Coffee
studies.caption: Coffee cherries grow in clusters along the branches. Their seeds, dried and roasted, carried a plant of the Ethiopian highlands into coffeehouses around the world.
studies.prompt: Close side view of Coffea arabica branch with opposite glossy wavy-edged leaves and small clusters of ripe red cherries at nodes. A few cherries opened naturally on a stone below showing paired pale seeds, tiny white star flowers on another branch. No coffee cups or brown roasted beans on plant.
